children: South Korea's finance minister said on Tuesday economic growth was seen in the 3% range this year as growth momentum was expanding.
Minister Lee Hyoung-il also said at a parliamentary session that authorities would make efforts to stabilise the foreign exchange market amid uncertainty over upward and downward factors for the won.
